PURGE RULES:

7. DELETE daily log files (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md) older than 30 days — they should be fully distilled into MEMORY.md by then
8. Clean up any stale entries in MEMORY.md that are no longer relevant (completed one-off tasks, resolved issues, outdated status)

## NEW PRIORITY 1: Short-term S&P 500 strategy
The quant team should now focus primarily on the short-term strategy track. Continue developing and testing short-horizon S&P 500 trading ideas with honest, rigorous evaluation. Improve `short_term_strategy.py` and related research artifacts. Explore signal families such as momentum, mean reversion, breakout, volatility, regime filters, and risk management variations. Favor realism over flattering results: explicit rules, transaction costs, sensible holding constraints, and walk-forward validation.

## NEW PRIORITY 2: Brainstorming new strategy ideas
"New business" should now spend its effort brainstorming genuinely new strategy directions rather than polishing existing documentation. Generate and evaluate fresh candidate ideas that are materially distinct from the current rotation strategy and the current short-term prototypes. Log ideas, hypotheses, and rejected paths clearly in `issue_tracker.log` or other appropriate research notes.

## BACKBURNER / DE-PRIORITIZED
- Existing rotation strategy maintenance should be backburnered unless a material issue appears in the latest daily run.
- `STRATEGY_PAPER.md`, README polish, and other documentation work should only receive minimal maintenance if needed.
- Do not spend substantial time refining the existing paper or repo presentation unless required by a significant strategy change.

## MINIMAL ROTATION CHECK
Review the latest rotation backtest only enough to confirm nothing is obviously broken. If a material issue appears, note it and address it; otherwise, leave it alone.

Commit AND PUSH all meaningful repo changes.

When done, write a concise summary report for Al on Telegram that emphasizes: 1) progress on the short-term strategy, 2) any new strategy ideas brainstormed, and 3) only brief status on the rotation strategy unless something important broke.
